otherReferences.paragraph: runtime/capture.py#Observer#code uses CPython disassembly without inline cache entries. Fused instructions retain their decoded identity; extended-argument instructions retain their offsets. IDs combine the recording's code identity and block-start offset, so repeated calls reuse geometry; IDs are not promised stable across source edits.
